## serious: target-size

All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space ([rule](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.14/target-size?application=axeAPI))

### /learn/glossary/

- `["a[href=\"#h\"]"]` — en; 4 occurrences. Fix any of the following:   Target has insufficient size (13.1px by 26px, should be at least 24px by 24px)   Target has insufficient space to its closest neighbors. Safe clickable space has a diameter of 22.6px instead of at least 24px.
- `["a[href=\"#i\"]"]` — en; 4 occurrences. Fix any of the following:   Target has insufficient size (5.3px by 26px, should be at least 24px by 24px)   Target has insufficient space to its closest neighbors. Safe clickable space has a diameter of 22px instead of at least 24px.
- `["a[href=\"#k\"]"]` — en; 4 occurrences. Fix any of the following:   Target has insufficient size (12.5px by 26px, should be at least 24px by 24px)   Target has insufficient space to its closest neighbors. Safe clickable space has a diameter of 22px instead of at least 24px.
